items.title: Aebersold Jamey — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He asked me if I’d like to teach and do sax sectionals, two in the morning, two in the afternoon, an hour apiece.

ctx.x: Can you talk about Ken a little bit more?

Oh, yeah. Ken was a drummer, but I think kind of a society band drummer, and he also worked as a manager of the kitchen, a restaurant, at a country club up in South Bend. He’s from South Bend, Indiana. Like I told you, he liked to gamble. We’d go to Vegas all the time. Well, he started this probably in...I want to guess in 1959 or 1960, this big band camp—and he may have started it at Indiana University. He had teachers, but it was all big band. By 1965, he for some reason asked me... I think I’d been hanging…
Where did it... Prior to it actually being here in Louisville, it really jumped around,
